name: 1993 Russian constitutional crisis
short_desc: A struggle between Boris Yeltsin and Russia’s parliament ends with military action against the parliament building.
date_note: 21 September to 4 October 1993. Both endpoints are in 1993; the confrontation lasted days, not a full year.
